## Personality

Milty Boulter is known for the deep pride he takes in his mother. This admiration stems from the common belief that she possesses the remarkable resourcefulness to scratch a living even on a rock.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0019)_

## History

Milty Boulter is a young [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) resident who attended school for a year prior to [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) Keith's arrival, making him somewhat experienced in Davy's eyes, and he once attended the funeral of his cousin Jane Ellen alongside his mother. In a letter written by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), Milty is mentioned as being involved in local school activities and neighborhood gossip. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) later complains about him while discussing schoolwork and local events with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), +128 more_
